description: This file contains driver implementation for the IT8XXX2 timer in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, interrupt handling, and timer control functions.

methods.name: timer_5ms_one_shot
methods.description: Configures and starts a one-shot timer to wake up the chip after 5ms for PLL change.

methods.name: arch_busy_wait
methods.description: Implements a busy-wait delay for a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: evt_timer_enable
methods.description: Enables and restarts the event timer.

methods.name: evt_timer_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for the event timer, handling tickless kernel updates.

methods.name: free_run_timer_overflow_isr
methods.description: ISR for the free run timer overflow, placeholder for 64-bit timer emulation.

methods.name: sys_clock_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the system clock timeout for the next tick.

methods.name: sys_clock_elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of elapsed ticks since last announcement.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current free run timer count.

methods.name: timer_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific external timer with given parameters.

methods.name: sys_clock_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes the system clock timers during system startup.
